name: Slingshot
author: supercleanse
description: Your newest downloads and screenshots, one click away. A bar icon drops down the latest files in Downloads and Pictures, with thumbnails. Drag one onto a terminal, browser, chat app, or file manager. Click a file to paste it into the window that was focused before the menu opened. Right-click copies it. The list updates as files arrive. An optional slingshot-ssh wrapper uploads a dropped file over SSH and types the remote path.

barWidget.description: Tray icon for your latest downloads and screenshots. Click it for the newest files in Downloads or Pictures, then drag one onto any app, or click a file to paste it into the window you were in. A dot appears when a new file lands.

schema.label: Show a dot when a new file arrives
